newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.818 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.818 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended November 16th was 4,818,314 gallons compared with 4,800,256 gallons last week.
Imports were 2,625,481 gallons compared with 1,066,823 gallons the previous week, and there were no domestic receipts this week compared to 43,359 gallons a week ago. Retail movement was 1,124,5366
gallons compared with 1,283,993 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 3,467,749 gallons versus 3,947,783 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 264,642,380 versus 265,206,006 a year ago.
Inventory was 44,763,235 versus 52,144,816 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 gallons compared with 216,502,392 gallons a year ago.
